doc: Tears down the periodic-update event: sets the critical-section-active flag (D_800737C0), enters a critical section, calls StopRCnt(0xF2000002), then disables and closes the event handle stored in D_80085F9C, exits the critical section, and finally clears the mode flag (D_80085F98) and the critical-section-active flag (D_800737C0).

globals.name: D_800737C0
globals.decl: extern s32 D_800737C0[4]; /* single s32 flag, forced hi/lo via size>8; slot [0] = critical-section-active flag (0/1), written before EnterCriticalSection and cleared before return; also read/written by sibling func_800585A0 */

globals.name: D_80085F9C
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80085F9C[4]; /* single s32 event handle, forced hi/lo via size>8; slot [0] holds the event id from OpenEvent (set in sibling func_800585A0), read here for DisableEvent/CloseEvent */

calls: StopRCnt(s32 arg) -> void  (called with 0xF2000002, an rcnt/hw id constant; psyq COUNTER.OBJ, named 2026-08-23 cd681dea -- was func_8006A27C)
